title: Prompt-target parity matrix: make its SessionStatus coverage compiler-enforced
outcome: src/tests/prompt_target_parity.rs derives its status cases from an exhaustive match on SessionStatus, with no wildcard. A new SessionStatus variant then fails to compile in this module until the parity matrix covers it, so the header's claim that it runs every SessionStatus variant stays true.
acceptance: Prompt-target parity matrix: make its SessionStatus coverage compiler-enforced is done
